newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe's TZI share offer over-subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's TZI share offer over-subscribed.

text.p: Southern African conglomerate Trans Zambezi Ltd (TZI), which plans to list on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange in mid-February, said on Wednesday that its share offer had closed over-subscribed.
Shareholders had until February 4 to apply for the two million TZI ordinary shares on offer at a price of US$3.25 per share.

ING Barings, who conducted the offer, received valid applications for 4.31 million TZI ordinary shares and TZI said it would accept all valid applications which would be placed into Zimbabwe Depository Receipts to facilitate the listing of TZI.
The ZDRs will be placed with institutional and other investors in Zimbabwe at or above US$3.25 per share.
Settlement for the TZI ordinary shares acquired pursuant to the offer will be on February 13.
TZI had extended its share offer subscription date from the previous January 30 cut-off date.
TZI has 46.3 million shares listed in Luxembourg. It will also be seeking listings in Lusaka and London.
